title: Aromatic Tunisian Sugar Stir-fry
description: A lazy-sunday snack that blends sweet ground sugar with savory Tunisian spices, creating a quick and low-fat stir-fry that satisfies both sweet and savory cravings.
instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and add the teaspoon of olive oil.
Add the minced garlic and ginger and sauté until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the diced sweet potato, carrot, and red bell pepper, stirring to combine.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Season with ground cumin, coriander, sea salt, and black pepper, stirring well.
Add the ground sugar and lemon juice, letting the flavors blend for 5 minutes.
Simmer until the vegetables are tender and the liquid has reduced to a glaze, about 10 minutes.
Serve hot, optionally garnishing with a sprinkle of fresh parsley if desired.
